Read-only: false

STDOUT:
#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=$'\n'$
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
[a,b]
